name: gridcraft-mcp-server
description: MCP server for GridCraft: sheets with live formulas, tables, formats, conditional formatting, charts and PivotTables, xlsx, csv, json, html and pdf, with GridCraft's own engine, from Claude (Windows, macOS, Linux).

scripts.pack:mcpb: npm run build && npx -y @anthropic-ai/mcpb pack . gridcraft-mcp-server.mcpb

author: Jhon Supelano (https://github.com/jhonsu01)

codex.shortDescription: Build, edit, analyze and convert spreadsheets with your local GridCraft
defaultPrompt: Build a monthly budget workbook with formulas, a chart and a summary sheet
Read this xlsx and tell me the total sales by region
Convert every workbook in this folder to CSV
